column3: extensions/stripe is a real adapter: createCheckout builds a Checkout Session with amount, currency and an Idempotency-Key, queryPayment and refund resolve a session id to its PaymentIntent, webhook.go verifies the t=,v1= signature over timestamp and raw body, and conformance_test.go drives the whole thing through extproto.Launch.
No PayPal adapter exists: gatewayProviders in internal/gatewayconfig/providers.go lists only stripe and fake, and extensions/ contains no PayPal process.

No legacy PayPal IPN listener: the protocol's only webhook entry is gateway.verify_webhook in internal/extproto/spec.go and no adapter exists to parse an IPN payment_status delivery or validate its POST-back.
No Mollie adapter: the two entries in gatewayProviders are Stripe and the fixture, and nothing under extensions/ speaks the Mollie API.

internal/marketplace can install an extension whose Kind is KindGateway after a SHA-256 check, but gatewayProviders in internal/gatewayconfig/providers.go is a closed two-entry list and no Razorpay, Coinbase or BTCPay adapter exists.

gatewayconfig.Resolver.Save stores one provider plus its credential Fields in the settings table and web/src/views/gateways.ts renders and edits them, but there are no gateway records: one gateway per installation and no create, delete, order or naming.

GET /api/v1/staff/gateways/test and /api/v1/staff/servers/test (handleTestGateway, handleTestServer) launch the saved configuration through gatewayconfig.Launch and report a failed describe as ok:false with the reason.

POST /api/v1/portal/invoices/{id}/checkout (handlePortalCheckout in internal/httpapi/checkout.go) records a payment_attempts row under an operation key and returns the adapter redirect_url, and extensions/stripe createCheckout sends the amount, currency and idempotency key.

payments.ExtensionVerifier delegates to gateway.verify_webhook, payments.Inbox.Receive stores the normalised payment_id beside the raw payload (0058_gateway_event_payment_id.sql) and Processor.processOne re-queries the provider with query_payment before applying anything.

Migration 0036_payment_methods.sql plus payments.Agreements Save, List, Get, SetDefault and Remove give a saved token with one database-enforced default, but no HTTP route or adapter token issuance is wired and internal/payments has no test for it.

payments.Agreements.ChargeInvoice and ChargeDue implement the gateway.off_session_enabled guard, payment_attempts reuse and settlement through Applier.ApplySettledPayment, but nothing implements OffSessionCharger and nothing calls ChargeDue, so no renewal is ever charged.

refunds.Service.Create writes the intent before calling Gateway.Refund, accepts a partial amount, leaves a timeout as unknown and Reconcile re-asks the provider, while billing derives payments.status partially_refunded or refunded from the refund rows.
payments.fee_minor exists (0020_commerce.sql) and handleStaffRecordPayment stores a fee_minor from the operator, but no gateway or webhook path records the provider's own fee.

handleStaffRecordPayment and handleRecordManualPayment with payments.RecordManual record money that arrived outside a gateway: provider manual, closed-set method and note from 0057_offline_payment_method.sql, a mandatory reference and the ordinary settlement applier.
payments.status covers succeeded, refunded, partially_refunded and disputed, and payment_attempts.status covers created, pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed and cancelled in 0001_core.sql.
payment_allocations is unique on (payment_id, invoice_id) and billing.Allocate accumulates invoices.amount_paid_minor without forcing paid, so two payments against one invoice are ordinary rows.

POST /api/v1/portal/invoices/{id}/pay-with-credit (handlePortalPayWithCredit) spends the customer's balance, and web/src/views/portal-invoice.ts offers it beside the gateway button with the remainder shown.

handlePortalPaymentMethods returns each configured gateway as id and name taken from gateway.describe Methods and /portal/payment-methods lists them, but there are no per-method icons and payment is still a hosted redirect with no pay modal.

GET /api/v1/portal/invoices/{id}/payment-status (handlePortalPaymentStatus) reports the local attempt status and derives settled from the allocation, but no web/src view calls it, so nothing in the UI polls.

services.status carries pending, provisioning, active, suspended, terminating, terminated and error with a services.generation fencing token, and subscriptions.status adds past_due and ended, which is stricter than the four upstream states.
services carries customer_id, product_id, order_id and quantity (0029_service_metadata.sql) and plan, price and currency come from subscriptions.price_version_id.
services.label is bounded and single-line and is editable by the customer through PUT /api/v1/portal/services/{id}/metadata and by staff through PUT /api/v1/staff/services/{id}/metadata.
service.deriveDescription in internal/service/metadata.go builds the description from product, plan, interval and the chosen config options, and the customer's own text wins as effective_description.

internal/renewal issues from subscriptions.next_billing_at on an internal/calendar anchor of day-of-month plus wall clock with clamping, and renewal re-reads the subscription price_version_id on every period.
service_holds (0006_dunning.sql) with an expiry is read by handleSuspensionEligibility, the dunning and termination automation and handleListHolds, so a hold really stops a suspend.
service_configs (0020_commerce.sql) stores the chosen options priced per price version and internal/httpapi/service_config.go validates, prices and reprices a change.
services.custom_properties jsonb plus service_property_definitions with show_on_invoice and customer_visible in 0029_service_metadata.sql, and a trigger refuses a value whose key has no definition.
service_cancellations (0020_commerce.sql) records type, reason and end date, with POST /api/v1/staff/services/{id}/cancellation, the portal request path and the /cancellations queue.
service_upgrades (0020_commerce.sql) plus internal/service/upgrades.go and POST /api/v1/staff/services/{id}/upgrade keep a half-applied change as a pending row instead of losing it.

extproto.ServiceAction and ui.describe with internal/httpapi/extension_hooks.go let an extension declare a service action that the core then calls with the declared permission checked, but no web/src view requests GET /api/v1/extensions/hooks, so no button is ever rendered.

POST /api/v1/staff/services (handleCreateService) creates, PUT /api/v1/staff/services/{id}/metadata edits and suspend, resume, terminate and cancellation change status, but there is no delete, no send-notification and no delete-remote action.
Nothing recomputes a service price from the catalogue: the only price change path is internal/service/upgrades.go, and 0029_service_metadata.sql says the plan and price come from the subscription.
internal/service ends the local subscriptions row on a cancellation, but no admin action and no extproto method cancels a provider-side subscription or billing agreement id.
staff.ServiceDetail.Invoices is returned by handleStaffService and web/src/views/service.ts renders an Invoices tab on the service screen.

provisioning.Worker.execute dispatches create, inspect, suspend, resume and terminate to the extproto provisioner methods and Reconcile uses provisioner.lookup, but there is no upgrade or replace call in the protocol or the worker.
service_operations is a durable queue with a unique operation_key, generations, leases, Worker.Reap for expired leases and Worker.Reconcile for unknown outcomes.

extensions/pterodactyl and extensions/cpanel are two real adapters against different APIs, but gatewayconfig.serverProviders registers only Pterodactyl plus the fixture so cPanel cannot be selected, and DirectAdmin, Plesk, Virtualizor, Virtfusion, Convoy and Enhance are absent.

gatewayconfig.Field with GET /api/v1/staff/servers/test gives credential fields and a connection test, but serverProviders in internal/gatewayconfig/providers.go lists only pterodactyl and fake, so the CPANEL_WHM_URL and CPANEL_API_TOKEN values have no form and never reach the child environment.
products.server_id from 0049_catalog_structure.sql with PUT /api/v1/staff/catalog/products/{id}/server and the servers CRUD routes in internal/httpapi/catalog_nesting.go.

extensions/pterodactyl environmentFor passes env.-prefixed metadata to the egg, but provisioning.Operation.metadata() emits only service_id, customer_id, server_id and server_node, so no chosen config option ever becomes an environment variable.

internal/service.apply enqueues a resize operation on a price change, but provisioning.Worker.execute has no resize case and fails it as an unsupported operation kind, and extproto has no provisioner.upgrade.
service_operations with Worker.Run, Reap and Reconcile replaces Paymenter's CreateJob, SuspendJob and TerminateJob, and termination removes the remote resource through provisioner.terminate.
